component.name: DNF Package Manager
component.summary: Fedora updates you can see and control

description.p: The Discover alternative for Fedora KDE. Every action runs the real DNF and Flatpak commands with live output, updates install right away instead of waiting for a restart, and you choose what gets updated: everything, everything except the kernel and graphics drivers, or security fixes only.
Keep Discover for browsing apps if you like. One click turns off its update checks so you don't get duplicate notifications, and one click brings them back.

ul.li: Combined DNF, Flatpak and security-advisory updates with download previews
Update without Major: upgrade everything except the kernel, graphics drivers, firmware and bootloader
Security-only upgrades and a reboot-required banner
Guided Fedora release upgrades when a new version is out
Discover takeover, background update reminders and optional passwordless updates
Search the Fedora repositories and install RPMs, with versions and source repository shown
Flatpak manager with Flathub search, repository and COPR manager, and transaction history with undo
System information dashboard, quick tools, and light and dark themes

screenshot.caption: Updates grouped by security fixes and major updates (dark)
Package details beside the update list (light)

description.p: A new native KDE Plasma interface built with Kirigami. It follows your Plasma colors, fonts and light or dark setting.

ul.li: The Updates page shows one clear status and one main button, with updates grouped into security fixes, major updates, everything else and Flatpak apps.
Package and transaction details open beside the list.
Command output follows you between pages, with live progress, Cancel and Copy Output.
Every page is redesigned, with keyboard and screen reader support throughout.

Security hardening: privileged commands run programs from system directories only, the app's own updates are checked again as root before installing, and the passwordless rule is validated before it takes effect.

description.p: Fixes a warning Qt printed at every start about the app's desktop file name.

Notifications are clickable. Clicking an update reminder, or its View Updates button, opens the Updates page with a fresh scan, even when the reminder came from the background check while the app was closed. Notifications show the app's icon and clearer text, and a failed operation's notification opens its output. Opening the app again brings the existing window forward.

Closing the window during an update no longer stops dnf partway: the operation finishes in the background. An offline update check no longer claims the system is up to date. On dnf5, the reboot banner notices core library updates again, and package details, the package list and history order are fixed.

Explains security updates that dnf skips because another package isn't ready for them yet, such as RPM Fusion's libheif-freeworld. The Updates page names the package holding them back and tags the affected updates Waiting. Security Only says when there's nothing to install yet, and Force Install lists exactly what it would remove. Every update run now reports skipped packages, and reminders no longer warn about updates that can't be installed yet.

Update reminders now work while the app is closed. A per-user systemd timer runs the check on your Check Every schedule, and a login check catches up when one was missed while the PC was off or asleep. Nothing polls in the background. Failed checks no longer silence reminders for a whole interval: they wait for the network and retry a few times.

Adds Update without Major (upgrade everything except kernel, graphics drivers, firmware and bootloader), guided Fedora release upgrades, per-package Mark Major, repository search and install, a single update button with a favorite mode, security tags and version changes on every update, and a Clean Up preview. Security fixes: the passwordless rule now covers only exact upgrade commands, and app self-updates are verified against a SHA-256 checksum. Fixes security advisory counts on dnf5, crashes when closing during background work, and many smaller issues.
Fix terminal worker execution hang and cancel operation behavior, sync login autostart with reminder switch, and add independent Flatpak reminders.
Combined updates, upgrade previews, reboot banner, package details dialog, Settings page (Discover takeover, reminders, passwordless updates), light/dark themes, adaptive vector icons, and UI polish.
